stemMd: If x>2, which expression must be positive?
explanationMd: For x>2, both x−2 and x+1 are positive, so their product is positive. Sign analysis suffices; all other expressions contain an unavoidable negative sign or difference.

distractorRationale.c: This is negative in the stated range.
distractorRationale.b: The first factor is negative and the second positive.
